blockers.detail: Closure-first queue still routes unresolved_material_contradiction for items whose existing resolver evidence already adjudicates the contradiction as resolved/non-gating. Remaining active packet failures are root-owner underwriting/source-integrity work. Repeating resolver strategy would violate anti-repeat and duplicate Council Alpha.

learning.repeatedBlocker: resolver disposition not consumed by deterministic packet/routing reconciliation
learning.failedStrategy: re-inspecting already-adjudicated contradiction without changed input
learning.changedStrategy: defer to root owner and deterministic reconciliation; do not repeat adjudication until input signature or contradiction evidence materially changes
learning.nextLawfulTrigger: materially changed contradiction evidence, changed input signature, genuine cross-lane deadlock, or Chief adjudication

notes: No new resolver evidence was created because no genuinely new resolver-owned factual contradiction was eligible among the closure-first frontier inspected. Existing immutable adjudications are preserved; canonical state, methodology, scores, ranks, ticks, membership, and Chief decisions were not modified.
